evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h.
rationale: Prevents the wallet from resubmitting unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool during startup, imports, and periodic rebroadcasts under `-privatebroadcast`. As cited in the PR description and issue #3828, automatic rebroadcasting can cause incoming dust payments or dropped transactions to be broadcast over clearnet, compromising user privacy.
